value.signature: fn reconstruct_replay (history : & ValidatedHistory , verifier : & impl RegistrationVerifier ,) -> Result < FormationGraph , RegistrationError >

review.body: { let acts = formation_context (history) ; let result = registration :: reconstruct_with (history , verifier , | act | checked_project (act , & acts , verifier , true)) ; if result . is_err () { tracing :: event ! (tracing :: Level :: TRACE , outcome = "refusal") ; } result }
review.item_premise: Finalized reconstruction checks complete public family structure, author approval and removal authority while retaining missing or misplaced public-parent targets. Inputs, output and typed refusals contain public evidence only. Observation supplies accounting, never a replay decision; no codec, digest or private carrier is introduced.
